suspicion: Exact-expiry full tick could be lost to same-time aura expiry
why_rejected: Periodic rank 5 precedes aura expiry rank 6 (state/transition.rs:25,70); probe holds_exact_expiry_tick_runs_before_aura_expiry.

suspicion: Stale periodic deadline survives refresh (double tick)
why_rejected: One deadline per schedule slot; commit upserts by slot (periodic.rs:483-496); refresh replaces the cell.

suspicion: SpellCastSpeed re-arm could resurrect a cell the child removed/refreshed
why_rejected: rearm_after_occurrence compares the full cell against the pre-fire snapshot and aborts on any change (periodic.rs:403-407).

suspicion: Zero-length terminal partial after a full tick exactly at expiry
why_rejected: pending_tick requires aura_expires_at > cadence_anchor for the terminal branch (periodic.rs:534-538).

suspicion: Capped carryover arithmetic deviates from direct consumers
why_rejected: floor(3d/10) carry with max(existing) equals simc DOT_REFRESH_PANDEMIC (action.cpp:4604) and Trinity min(new+rem, 130%) (Spell.cpp:3284-3287) except Trinity may shorten when remaining > 130%, which Core deliberately never does.
Consumers disagree (UNK-E-002); Core matches simc and its own catalog contract; not provable.

suspicion: Resource-threshold crossing predicate off-by-one vs Trinity
why_rejected: Core gain before<T<=after / loss before>T>=after is identical to Trinity TriggerOnPowerChangeAuras (Unit.cpp:10144-10153).

suspicion: AddStacks on passive-flow modifier auras changes flow rate without rebase (retroactive projection)
why_rejected: Flat/percentage carriers must be max_stacks==1 single-deadline (passive_flow_flat/validation.rs:321-332, passive_flow_percentage/validation.rs:328-332).

suspicion: Haste changes retroactively re-project passive flow
why_rejected: Only runtime haste writer is active casting speed; its commit settles before and rebases/replans after (state/active_casting_speed.rs:8-46; execution/commit.rs:631-635).

suspicion: Independent-stack aura final expiry skips raw-495 driver
why_rejected: Combination unreachable: expiry owners with AsynchronousStackingBuff reject (expiry.rs:14-18) and independent lifetime requires it (aura_lifetime.rs:20-21).

suspicion: Periodic cell committed for missed impact while aura not applied (or vice versa)
why_rejected: Aura commit and periodic workspace commit share impact_landed (execution/commit.rs:617-619, 1010).

Occurrence-current evaluation is documented and matches retail/simc dynamic dots; Trinity snapshots SpellDamageBonusDone into _estimatedAmount (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:872-895) — consumer disagreement, not a Core defect.

suspicion: Periodic work of a dead aura SOURCE should stop
why_rejected: Core keeps ticking (child damage lands). Trinity gates periodic damage only on target liveness (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5632-5635) and RemoveAllAurasOnDeath removes only the dying unit's own applied auras (Unit.cpp:4472-4493); inferred retail parity.

suspicion: Haste-affected duration alignment (Venom 391428) diverges from Trinity
why_rejected: aligned = max(d/p,1)*p with hastened period equals Trinity Spell.cpp:3270-3278.
